name: alasql
description: Use SQL to select and filter javascript data - including relational joins and search in nested objects (JSON). Export to and import from Excel and CSV
author: Andrey Gershun <agershun@gmail.com>

scripts.test: yarn test-parser && yarn build-only && yarn test-only
scripts.test-ci: (yarn test-format-all || 1) && yarn test-only && yarn install-g && alasql 'select 1 as Succes'
scripts.test-parity: yarn build-only && BASE=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD | cut -c1-12) && bun test/parity/run.js record ref-$BASE --ref $BASE --if-missing && bun test/parity/run.js record new --once && bun test/parity/run.js compare ref-$BASE new
scripts.build-only: bun build.js && rexreplace PACKAGE_VERSION $npm_package_version -Iq 'dist/**/*.js' && rexreplace BUILD_VERSION "'$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)'.replace(/[^\da-z-]+/gi, '.')" -Iqj 'dist/**/*.js'
scripts.install-g: yarn build && npm uninstall alasql -g && npm install -g .
scripts.test-format: yarn pretty-since-dev --list-different || (echo 'Please correct file formatting using `yarn format` and try again.' && exit 1)
scripts.test-format-all: prettier --list-different '{.,src,test}/**/*.{js,ts,json}' || (echo 'Please correct file formatting using `yarn format-all` and try again.' && exit 1)
scripts.pretty-since-dev: { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d origin/main ; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d --staged origin/main ; } | sort | uniq | grep -vE '^dist/|^test/coverage|^lib/|.min.js$' | grep -E '\.(scss|css|js|ts|vue|json)$' | xargs npx prettier
scripts.pretty-commit: { git diff --name-only  --diff-filter=d ; git diff --name-only  --diff-filter=d --staged ; } | sort | uniq | grep -vE '^dist/|^test/coverage|^lib/|.min.js$' | grep -E '\.(scss|css|js|ts|vue|json)$' | xargs npx prettier
scripts.pretty-all: git ls-tree --full-tree --name-only -r HEAD | grep -vE '^dist/|^test/coverage|^lib/|.min.js$' | grep -E '\.(scss|css|js|ts|vue|json)$' | xargs npx prettier
scripts.amend: git reset --soft HEAD~1 && sleep 1 && git add --all && git commit --file .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG
scripts.version: rexreplace 'alasql@\d+(\.\d+){2}' alasql@$npm_package_version -q README.md && git add README.md
scripts.postversion: npm publish && git push && git push origin v$npm_package_version && echo "Successfully released version $npm_package_version"
